sources.entry: Tellor - Minimalist single-user kanban todo app. Clean, simplified, and compact UI. Can import boards from Trello. (Demo, Source Code) MIT PHP

summary.one_liner: Tellor is a minimalist, single-user kanban to-do app with no authentication, written in plain PHP and vanilla JavaScript, that can import boards from Trello.
summary.what_it_does: Tellor is a Trello-style kanban board app with a simplified, compact interface and only core features. It runs on a LAMP stack, with PHP serving an API backed by a MySQL or MariaDB database. It has no login or user accounts, since it is designed for a single user. Boards can be imported from Trello JSON exports, and Tellor's own boards can be exported to JSON. The README says the app is mobile friendly and uses no libraries, frameworks, or dependencies.
use_cases: moving a Trello board to a self-hosted app
simple to-do lists on a local network
lightweight task board for one person
how_to_run: Clone the repo into a web directory
(optional) Open setup-db.sh and set the DB user options
(optional) Copy DB credentials into api.php line 6
Run ./setup-db.sh as root to create the database
notable: Imports boards from Trello JSON exports
Clean, compact UI with core features only
Simple code meant to be easy to modify
caveats: No authentication, so anyone who can reach the board can modify it; meant for a private network or behind a reverse proxy
Requires a LAMP-style server with PHP 7+ and MySQL/MariaDB
Tellor boards cannot be exported back to Trello
